title: Letter and Inheritance
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Xanthe Halloran, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
